name: Leather Spy Date
hook: Trade GPU secrets over candlelit dim sum before the feds breach the booth
tagline: A leather-jacketed tech CEO slips confidential AI wafers under dim sum platters across a moody bistro table. Cash out to scoop the check and slip into the alleyway limousine before the feds kick in the doors. Crash and microphones pop out of the soup dumplings as flashbangs blind the dining room.
